method: Read-only production PostgreSQL aggregates with 30 second statement timeout and Redis LRANGE/MGET capped at 10000 jobs per priority
limitations: Acquisition recovered on September 10. First-seen identities and terminal detections are catch-up observations, not normal daily market turnover. Zero detections during poor coverage do not mean zero demand.

Published counts only cover acquired rows; incomplete geographic coverage and missing publication dates preclude a full national census. One future publication date was excluded from period summaries.

Core address definition requires nonempty street/city, four digits plus two letters postcode and numeric house number. Some unusual valid address forms or individual new-build listings can require identity-level resolution rather than a paid detail request.
Different address IDs within a global-ID group indicate a reconciliation risk, not a proven conflicting app property link. No blind merge is justified.

Stored terminal status events classify legacy listing_history values; legacy evidence has no per-event v2 collector provenance, so these counts do not independently establish explicit source confirmation for every withdrawn event.
Legacy price-history/full-sync/backward-scan jobs are removed by the milestone. Their queue length is not an essential-detail demand estimate.
The initial final inventory must measure missing identities and essential unresolved address demand before the remaining-cycle paid-only forecast can be accepted.

approved_bootstrap_policy.authority: Milestone lead coordination, 2026-09-13; applies the product 30-day availability eligibility policy
approved_bootstrap_policy.confirmation_cohort: Current-eligible unique listing identities absent from a completed national sale-and-rent inventory union
approved_bootstrap_policy.cohort_evidence_rule: Union observations must be newer than the cohort positive evidence; migration time is never confirmation time
approved_bootstrap_policy.expired_history: Rows whose last positive availability confirmation is older than 30 days retain facts and history; do not create a blanket paid detail backlog solely from their legacy available status
approved_bootstrap_policy.recovery: An actual newer positive inventory observation restores eligibility under normal evidence ordering
approved_bootstrap_policy.forecast: Replace initial uncertainty estimates with measured final complete inventory, unresolved core evidence and mandatory demand; do not reduce demand merely to fit credit allowance

eligible_cohort_followup.qualification: Point-in-time read-only count; cutover must freeze actual cohort against complete inventory evidence, including typed alias reconciliation. Different publication completeness and acquired coverage prevent interpreting this as full national inventory.
